messages:
jordan_acct: Hey team — trying to redeem voucher code REDW-TRIAL-24 on account jordan@acme.com and dashboard returns "Code invalid or expired". Partner said they issued it earlier today. Screenshot attached.

maya_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact code you tried (no screenshots of hidden chars) and whether this was via the dashboard or the API? Also share account org id if possible.

jordan_acct: Code is REDW-TRIAL-24 (copied from partner email). Tried in dashboard first, then via API. Org id: org_6732. Repro steps: Settings > Billing > Redeem voucher -> paste -> Redeem -> error. Dashboard shows toast: "Voucher invalid or expired".

maya_support: Thanks. Can you try the API quick check and paste the response? curl example:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/credits/redeem \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -d '{"code":"REDW-TRIAL-24","org_id":"org_6732"}'
```

jordan_acct: Ran it, response: 

```
HTTP/1.1 409 Conflict
{
  "error": "redeem_failed",
  "reason": "stale_promo_cache",
  "promo": "REDW-TRIAL-24"
}
```

jira-bot: Incident created: INC-1234 (auto).

maya_support: OK that's interesting — the API is returning stale_promo_cache rather than classical expired. Tagging eng. @leo_engineer can you take a look?

leo_engineer: Looking. Can you confirm the partner that issued the voucher and the approximate time it was created? Also any partner import job ids?

jordan_acct: Partner is partner_integrations/acme-partner, they said they created it at 08:45 PDT (~2024-05-28T15:45:00Z). No job id from them.

leo_engineer: Thanks. Pulling logs for org_6732 and code REDW-TRIAL-24. I see a promo metadata row created in DB at 2024-05-28T15:45:05Z marking start/end dates valid. But the cache layer (promo-metadata-cache) still had an earlier revocation marker from a previously deleted placeholder promo id. Cache TTL should have been invalidated by the import flow but looks like CDN invalidation failed for that partner namespace. That would cause the redemption service to treat the code as revoked/expired until the cache entry expired (~12h).

sara_support: So that explains "invalid/expired" UX even though DB shows it valid. What's the immediate mitigation? Customer needs credits now.

leo_engineer: Two things: 1) Manual fix: purge promo cache for partner namespace and re-run the partner import invalidate hook. 2) Short-term customer-facing: manually grant the trial credits to org_6732 and mark the redemption as completed to avoid double-claim. I'll coordinate purge now.

ops-bot: Cache purge job started for namespace partner_integrations/acme-partner (job id cp-8891).

leo_engineer: Cache purge completed (cp-8891). Re-tested redeem endpoint in staging path against production metadata: now returns 200 with credit allocation.

maya_support: I manually granted 14 days trial / $150 credit to org_6732 to match the voucher terms while we confirm idempotency. Created billing ticket BILL-98765 to reconcile and ensure no double-billing.

jordan_acct: Thanks — I can confirm dashboard now shows the applied credit and usage limit updated. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

leo_engineer: Root cause: partner import didn't consistently invalidate promo cache when replacing placeholder records under load — race left a stale revocation key in the cache. Fixes: add guaranteed cache invalidation after partner imports and add a short-lived fallback check that queries DB when API returns stale_promo_cache. Filed bug INC-1234 and fix pr queued (eng/pr#4567).

maya_support: Closing loop with customer and adding note to partner support to re-run their import hooks. Jordan, I'll leave this thread open for 24h in case anything else pops up.

jordan_acct: All good from our side. Thanks @maya_support and team! :pray:
